# Murman Engineering India Pvt Ltd

> Built like a banyan. Navi Mumbai firm that makes commercial buildings in Maharashtra cooler and lower in carbon: near-zero emission design and green building certification, low-carbon fit-out and materials, clean construction, roof cooling and retrofit. Vocabulary follows UNEP and GlobalABC: near-zero emission and resilient buildings, whole-life carbon, circular economy. Founded 2025. The team's record is finishing work (stone, tiling, waterproofing) on 55+ projects since 1991. Murman has not yet delivered a green certification.

## Pages
- [Murman Engineering](https://www.murmanengineering.com/): Murman Engineering designs, fits out and retrofits commercial buildings in Maharashtra to near-zero emission, climate-resilient standards: green certification, low-carbon materials, clean construction and roof cooling.
- [Services](https://www.murmanengineering.com/services/): Five services for commercial buildings across design, construction, fit-out and operation, plus five small entry offers. Prices are quoted on scope.
- [Near-zero emission design and green building certification](https://www.murmanengineering.com/services/near-zero-design-certification/): Feasibility, choice of rating, energy-efficient design and the green FSI case, carried through certification with accredited professionals.
- [Low-carbon, circular fit-out and finishing](https://www.murmanengineering.com/services/low-carbon-fit-out/): Stone, tile, waterproofing and interiors, specified and executed with low-carbon, low-emission and recycled-content materials.
- [Low-carbon materials and circularity](https://www.murmanengineering.com/services/low-carbon-materials/): Concrete mixes, blocks and a carbon-costed BOQ that cut embodied carbon, with a recycled-content plan under the 2025 waste rules.
- [Clean construction and environmental compliance](https://www.murmanengineering.com/services/clean-construction/): Dust, debris and clearance conditions checked on site every month, so the site keeps running.
- [Operational performance and retrofit](https://www.murmanengineering.com/services/operations-retrofit/): Energy audit, roof cooling, and lighting and cooling upgrades for buildings in use, with a partner who can be repaid from the savings.
- [Roof cooling for existing buildings](https://www.murmanengineering.com/roof-cooling/): Cool roofs for commercial buildings in the Mumbai region: survey, repair, waterproofing and a reflective finish in one job, measured before and after.
- [Retrofit: before and after](https://www.murmanengineering.com/retrofit/): What a green retrofit changes in a glass-facade office and in a warehouse, with measured results from Mumbai retrofits.
- [Why green buildings](https://www.murmanengineering.com/why-green/): A plain guide for owners and engineers: what a green building is, what it costs, what the owner gets back, and which rules are coming.
- [About Murman Engineering](https://www.murmanengineering.com/about/): Why Murman builds like a banyan, the team's finishing record since 1991, and how the firm works.
- [Contact](https://www.murmanengineering.com/contact/): Book a 30-minute meeting with Murman Engineering in Navi Mumbai, by phone, WhatsApp or the request form.
- [Privacy note](https://www.murmanengineering.com/privacy/): What this website collects and how Murman Engineering uses it.
- [Green FSI estimator](https://www.murmanengineering.com/tools/green-fsi/): free calculator for additional floor area under UDCPR green building incentives in Maharashtra
